description: Render a customer's cross-layer dashboard — what they pay (monthly), their active entitlements, and their database read-cost, joined by identity — and return the same as a text summary. Returns a rendered dashboard in MCP-Apps-capable hosts (a text summary elsewhere). Identify the customer by ANY ONE of the identifiers below; they all resolve to the same canonical customer. Use when asked to show, open, or visualize a customer's full picture. Returns a no-match result if no customer resolves.

anonymousId.description: A pre-login anonymous/device id captured before sign-in.

appleOriginalTransactionId.description: Apple StoreKit originalTransactionId for the purchase.

googlePurchaseToken.description: Google Play purchase token for the purchase.

project.description: The app to read (its project id, from list_projects). Required with a workspace key unless set via use_project.

userId.description: Your own user id for this person — the value you pass to identify() (e.g. 'user_847').

name: open_moat_dashboard
title: Open the cross-layer dashboard
